title: core.event.v1 HoldExpired payload
description: The core released a hold whose time ran out before it was committed or released (ticket 94, FRS 7.3; mw.coremock.hold-ttl, default 30 min): amount + fee are available again, a later CommitHold fails HOLD_EXPIRED and a ReleaseHold succeeds without effect. Published once per hold.

walletId.description: The payer whose funds were held

fee.description: The fee that was held with the amount (VAT included)
